text: A Japanese city street scene viewed from a low puddle-level perspective, with a yellow taxi parked on the left, two smaller vehicles in the middle distance, and a tall parking sign pole on the right. The camera slowly tracks rightward and forward along the street, gradually moving past the taxi and sign pole while the two distant vehicles remain relatively stationary. Buildings with Japanese signage line both sides of the narrow urban street, and a perfect water reflection mirrors the scene below.
